# RESEARCH_INDEX - what already exists in this checkout

**GENERATED by `python Tools/gen_index.py`. Do not hand-edit - a hand-kept
index stops tracking its subject the first time it is not updated.**

Generated at `e0f584ce`. 2728 research documents, 2043 task files, 0 Godot tools, 109 drivers.

## HOW TO USE THIS - GREP IT, DO NOT READ IT WHOLE

This file is large on purpose. Reading it end to end costs more than the
exploration it exists to replace. Search it:

```
grep -in 'clinch' RESEARCH_INDEX.md          # every artefact mentioning clinch
grep -in 'capsule\|overlap' RESEARCH_INDEX.md
grep -in 'anim\|retarget\|clip' RESEARCH_INDEX.md
```

Then read only the two or three documents that match. A research document
here is a FINDING, not an instruction: it reports what was true when it was
written, and if it names a file, a function or a flag, check the thing still
exists before building on it.

**A NEGATIVE RESULT IS A RESULT.** Several documents here record that
something does NOT work - paired clip generation, a purchasable grappling
pack, a numbered referee break clock. Those are the most expensive findings
in the set and re-running them wastes a pass.
